verdict.rationale: A keyless runtime probe confirmed that https://learn.chatgpt.com/llms.txt returns 200 text/plain with a dedicated '## Dots' section listing every dots doc page. Each page is fetchable as raw markdown (e.g. docs/dots.md returned 200 text/markdown), and the page itself says .md versions exist for any doc URL. The earlier docs-md 404 was an artifact of appending .md twice. missing for 10: a dots-specific agent index (the llms.txt is a shared vendor index headed '# Codex'), independent community corroboration of agent use.
